trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer for dashboard performance
trello.desc: Owner: Raj. Task: Set up a load test mirroring the dashboard's query pattern to benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode against the current setup. Compare p95 latency with and without PgBouncer. Deadline: Results required by the next sync. Context: Dashboard slowness is caused by database connection contention, not query cost; staying on Postgres.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Owner: Tom. Task: Fix the typo 'recieve' to 'receive' in the onboarding email subject line. Push the fix through the email template repo and get it re-approved. Deadline: Today. Context: Marketing spotted the error; estimated effort is five minutes.

trello.name: Update roadmap document regarding dark mode
trello.desc: Owner: Tom. Task: Update the roadmap document to remove dark mode from 'Q3 committed' and move it under the 'September design-system upgrade' line. This ensures sales does not promise it as a standalone feature. Deadline: Immediately after the meeting. Context: Dark mode will be included for free with the September design-system upgrade, so no separate development task is needed.
